title: Physics-informed Graph Neural Networks for Operational Flood Modeling
why_relevant: Directly targets flood forecasting on graphs with physics-informed losses and multi-step curriculum learning; highly aligned with coupled 1D–2D flood dynamics and autoregressive inference.
extracted_technique: DUALFloodGNN-style message passing that jointly predicts node water variables and edge flows, trained with multi-step loss + dynamic curriculum and explicit physics constraints.
query: Physics-informed Graph Neural Networks for Operational Flood Modeling arXiv 2512.23964
takeaway: Use a coupled-graph forecaster with auxiliary edge-flow prediction and physics regularizers, trained with multi-step curriculum to improve long-horizon rollout stability.

title: Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting
why_relevant: A proven template for long-horizon forecasting on directed graphs using diffusion convolution and seq2seq with scheduled sampling; maps well to hydraulic network flow propagation.
extracted_technique: Diffusion convolution on directed graphs + encoder–decoder recurrent model + scheduled sampling for autoregressive training/inference alignment.
query: Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network arXiv
takeaway: Adopt diffusion-based spatial mixing and scheduled sampling/curriculum to reduce error accumulation across multi-step forecasts on directed drainage/surface graphs.

title: Graph WaveNet for Deep Spatial-Temporal Graph Modeling
why_relevant: Efficient, high-performing spatiotemporal baseline (TCN + graph conv) with adaptive adjacency that can capture missing dependencies; suitable as strong fallback if physics-GNN is unstable.
extracted_technique: Dilated causal temporal convolutions for long receptive field + graph convolution with learnable adaptive adjacency matrix via node embeddings.
takeaway: Implement a pure-PyTorch Graph WaveNet-style model to get a fast, strong STGNN baseline and optionally learn hidden couplings beyond the provided edge indices.
